line1Words.4: lok ma ki mako ki dwan

Home.subtitle: Paste kwena, gin ma kubu onyo i keto media. Zuula waci ni ka tye ada, goba onyo AI-ma kiyubu — ki <scribble>nyuti in kama oaa iye</scribble>.

carousel.start: Cak yubu slide ma tye ka wot

community.title: Ngo ma Uganda tye ka ngiyo
community.trending: Tye ka time i cabit man

banner.title: I kom
banner.description: Miti wa, yoo me tic ki bedo agonya i lok ma kicoyo.

why.title: Kiyubu pi kit ma lok angeya woto kwede i Uganda.

sources.title: Kabedo ma genne
sources.body: Lok ma ki waco ni tye ada ki ngiyo ne ki dul me Uganda kacel ki lobo mukene ki jo ma gi ngiyo lok ada.

ai.title: AI nongo jami ma tye
ai.body: Cal ma ki yubu AI-ma kiyubu ki coc, cal ma ki loko lok iye, dwan ma kiyubu ki vidio ma ki loko.

languages.title: Leb me Uganda
languages.body: Lingala, Luganda, Acholi, Runyankole ki Ateso.

mission.title: Uganda neno wel lok ma ki cwalo ne dano mapol nino ki nino. Zuula ngiyo gi ma pud pe i nywako ne.
mission.body: Zuula (ma kiyubu ki Uganda Fact-Guard) obedo AI-kony me ngiyo lok ada ma kiyubu pi kit ma lok angeya woto kwede kany — i WhatsApp, i lok me gurup ki i kabedo me nywako lok, pol kare oyot loyo kit ma ot poko lok angeya mo keken twero moko ne. Mi lok ma iwaco ci inong tam ma jenge i kom caden, pe tam keken.

methodology.title: Kit ma wacobo kwede lok
methodology.description: Pimo acel acel lubu yoo angwen ma rom, kadi bed ni ki tiyo kwede onyo ki cwalo ne bot ngat mo me ngiyo.

submit.title: I cwalo lok me kwac
submit.body: Ket coc, nywak ki yoo me kube onyo ket jami ma ineno (ma oo 50 MB). Inongo namba me lubu kor ID ki itwero lubu kwed ne kare ki kare.

check.title: Watye ka ngiyo ne
check.body: Lok ne ki ngiyo i kom lok ma genne pa dano me Uganda ki lobo mawoko, ki ngiyo pi AI-ma kiyubu ki coc, deepfakes ki audio onyo vidio ma ki yubo.

publish.title: Kikatti ki ngolo kop
publish.body: Ineno kop ma ki ngolo, caden matye i ngeye ki yoo mene ma giyee onyo pe giyee — pe obedo alama keken.

review.title: Lwak ki jo ma ngiyo lok gi miyo tam
review.body: Lukwan pimo tam ma kimoko. Ka dano mapol pe giyee, ladiro ma ki yee ni ngiyo lok ne dok twero moko onyo kwanyo woko — adwogi tic ne dong ki keto alama iye ni “Dano oyee.”

independence.title: Cik ma wamako kenwa
independence.description: Zuula pe cato ngolo kop, dok bene pe dong otyeko labongo yo me pyem iye.

label.title: Wan wacoyo nying, pe wa jwayo
label.body: Zuula pe kwanyo coc pa ngat mo keken. Wa coyo lok ma ki ngolo ki caden kacel kwede.

rules.title: Rwom me ngiyo jami weng tye ki cik marom
rules.body: Lwak, lucoo lok angeya ki ludiro ma gi miyo tam gi konyo me nongo rwom me gen pa lwak, ma ki keto iye pek malube ki rekod me tic — pe tye ngat mo ma bolo kwir ne ki kwero labongo tyen lok.

accountable.title: Lungol tic gi tiyo ticgi
accountable.body: Ludiro ma gitye ki ngec me tic gi mito ni omyero kicoyo lok ma moko tam ne dok bene kicoyo i buk pa ludito ma twero ngiyo.

sources.title: Kama oaa iye kinyutu, pe okanne
sources.body: Ripot weng kubu caden ma ki ngiyo, pi meno itwero moko tam wa in ikomi.

whatsapp.title: Ngi lok ma aa ki bot WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Pe tye app, pe tye data bundle pi browser — cwalo kwena ki nongo adwogi ne i lok me coko tam.
whatsapp.body: A WhatsApp ki Telegram bot kiyubu pi yub me API pa platform, dong ibi bedo ki kero me cwalo kwena atir bot Zuula kit ma dong icwalo ne bot luremi. Pe tye ka tic kombedi — pi kombedi, ti ki <link>Ngiyo</link> iwi yamo.

faq.title: Lapeny ma ki penyo kare ki kare

free.q: Zuula tye agonya me tic kwede?
free.a: Ngiyo lok ki kwano Library tye me nono pi dano weng. Journalist ki Expert accounts mito accreditation, pien gin gi tingo pek madit i community score dok twero ngiyo lok ma ki keto alama iye.

submit.a: Text (calo WhatsApp ma cito anyim), kubu, coc weng, onyo jami me mako lok — cal, dwon ki vidio ma oo 50 MB.

time.q: Pimo cente tero kare ma rom mene?
time.a: Lok ma kicoyo ipol kare tero cekon 10. Media twero tero dakika acel. Lok ma ki cwalo bot ngat ma ngeyo lok me ngiyo ne lubu agiki me ngiyo ne me kakare.

verdicts.q: Adwoki me ngolo kop ni tye ki tyen lok ango?

disagree.q: Ka ce pe acwako kop ma ki ngolo?
disagree.a: Ket rwom ne. Rwom ma aa ki bot lwak, lucoo lok angeya ki ludiro ki ribo gi i Community Confidence Score. Ka adwogi me ngolo kop opoto piny tutwal ki rwom ma oromo, ki keto alama pi ladiro me ngiyo ki moko onyo kwanyo woko.

languages.a: Kwac twero ngiyo i leb munu, Luganda, Acholi, Runyankole ki Ateso. Kabedo ne bene tye ka gonyo i leb magi bene; gin mo keken ma pud pe kigonyo nen i leb munu.

data.a: I te cik me Uganda's Data Protection and Privacy Act, 2019. Nen <link>Cik me mung</link> wa.

who.q: Anga ma yubu ki miyo cente me Zuula?
who.a: Zuula (“Uganda Fact-Guard”) kiyubu ki Centre for Intelligent Technologies i Victoria University Kampala macalo yub me kwan ki miti pa lwak. Ngolo kop ki nongo ne labongo jami mo keken ma miyo cente onyo lacat wil.

contact.title: Nong lok
contact.description: Lapeny ma mako lok me ngolo kop, kabedo onyo ribbe.

general.title: Lapeny mapat-pat
general.body: Lok me poko lok angeya, ribbe ki lapeny me yoo me tic.

privacy.metaDescription: Kit ma Zuula coko, tiyo ki gwoko ngec ma mako in.
privacy.title: Mung
privacy.description: Kit ma wan wayubu, watiyo ki dok wagwoko kwede lok ma mako komi.

overview.title: Neno weng
overview.body: Cik man tito ngo ma Zuula coko ka ineno lok me cul, yeny i Library onyo cako akaunt, ki kit ma ngec meno kitiyo kwede ki gwoko ite cik me Cik me gwoko ngec ki mung, 2019 me Uganda. Tiyo pi website me Zuula ki, ka dong ocako tic, WhatsApp ki Telegram bots ki partner API.

items.account: Lok matut i kom akaunt — nying, email onyo nama cim, ki tic (Lwak, Lacoo lok angeya, Ngat ma tye ki ngec onyo latic).
items.submissions: Coyo lok — coc, kubu onyo jami ma in ipenyo Zuula me ngiyo, ki lubu kor ID ma kimiyo.
